experiment.masteryDefinition: Observed production U.S. Memory Trail item status; thresholds and state transitions are not reimplemented by this reporter.

profile.label: Perfect learner
profile.description: Correct on almost every encounter, with a rare deterministic miss.

fullErrorFreePass.note: U.S. Memory Trail does not define or record a full-pass event over all introduced material.

domainCompletionState.note: The U.S. Memory Trail state has no journey/domain-complete field separate from item status.

profile.label: Single weak item learner
profile.description: Always misses Ohio and answers other items correctly.

reviewLoadAfterIntroduction.reason: All curriculum items were not introduced within the simulation horizon.

profile.label: Regional weakness learner
profile.description: Strong in the Northeast and persistently weaker in the Midwest.

profile.label: Mixed learner
profile.description: Combines regional differences, occasional errors, and a return gap.

profile.label: Seeded random learner
profile.description: Answers with a seeded stochastic-looking 55% success rate.
